title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jd: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems. We are hiring an engineer to design and ship multi-agent systems for financial services clients. You will build agent workflows with LangGraph, including planning, tool calling and human approval steps. You will build retrieval pipelines (RAG) and measure their quality with automated evaluation. You will connect agents to real systems through tools and MCP servers with proper authentication. Experience fine-tuning large language models is required. You will mentor other engineers and set engineering standards. A record of peer-reviewed machine learning research publications is a plus.

title: AI Solution Architect
jd: AI Solution Architect. You will work with enterprise customers to scope, design and deliver AI solutions. Responsibilities: run discovery and requirements workshops with business stakeholders; design end-to-end architectures for LLM applications on AWS, including data, retrieval, evaluation and security; build proofs of concept and hand over to delivery teams; deploy infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD. Requirements: 5+ years building production software; hands-on experience with RAG and agent frameworks; experience deploying on-premise or air-gapped AI systems for regulated clients; strong written communication. Nice to have: experience with Kubernetes at scale and SAP integrations.
